source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"In small, titrated doses, with awareness that its effect may wear off before the benzodiazepine, risking re-sedation","B":"As a single dose intended to be given just once, with fairly little further monitoring considered necessary afterward","C":"With fairly little risk of any meaningful complications arising from its administration to the client","D":"As one large dose given all at once, regardless of how the client happens to respond to the initial amount given"}}
source_row.rationale: Flumazenil is typically given in small, titrated doses, and the nurse should be aware its duration of action may be shorter than the benzodiazepine being reversed, creating a risk of re-sedation requiring continued monitoring.
